question: GUI in the context of computers stands for:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Graphic User Interface.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **GUI (graphical user interface):**

 
 
• It is a system of** interactive visual components for computer software**.
 
• A GUI displays objects that **convey information, and represent actions **that can be taken by the user.
 
• The objects change **color, size, or visibility** when the user interacts with them.
 
• It allows users to interact with electronic devices through graphical icons and an audio indicator such as primary notation, instead of text-based user interfaces, typed command labels, or text navigation.
